datasets.title: South Sudan - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in South Sudan with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/south-sudan-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters within South Sudan regions, assigning representative points to each cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts from multiple sources (WorldPop 2020, Kontur 2023, Meta 2023) were aggregated and disaggregated by sex and age groups within each catchment. Building counts from OpenStreetMap and Google were attributed to settlements to create a baseline inventory of structures and population at risk.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to identify settlement clusters and disaggregate population counts

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: Alternative population dataset (2023) providing population estimates per settlement catchment area

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Population data disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) for demographic analysis within settlements

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data (2024) used to count structures within settlement catchment areas

sources.name: Google
sources.description: High-confidence building detection data (70%+ and 80%+ confidence thresholds) for building inventory validation
